svg.title: The new conversion-test pipeline
svg.desc: Five stages: the conversion manager has an idea and builds the variant in a Figma Make template, a designer QA gate checks for at least 90% brand compliance and sends weaker variants back to the template, the conversion manager runs the live test, and the designer refines winners to 100% before rollout. Every result feeds the next idea. Idea to live test takes two days at most, with no developer in the loop.

g.text: every result feeds the next idea

svg.text: 2 days max, no developer in the loop
